purpose: Evaluate whether the private candidate improves cost and performance without degrading task outcomes. Superiority is not assumed.

design.primary: native Web profile Hosts and their actual session, skill and delegation services
design.diagnostic: direct-model/context experiments must be reported separately and cannot establish runtime superiority
design.pilot: one small case in all four arms; never counted as held-out evidence
design.ordering: rotate arm order within each paired task/repetition; serial tasks, natural concurrent children
design.content: identical normalized Skill definitions, role responsibilities, inputs, requested outputs and rubric; native loading policy remains unchanged in each baseline. Public distraction Skills are copied into the same reserved test namespace in every arm; their resource scripts are not execution targets.
design.explicitSelection: For single-Skill and fixed workflows, official DSH receives its native /skill gesture; QS receives its native persisted attachments. Dynamic cases retain each product's native selection. Official Team uses its experimental agent-team profile; QS uses its saved Team definition.
design.skillParity: Preflight verifies each installed root-visible Skill body against the normalized fixture; team members have the same role responsibilities and assigned Skill subsets. Official project catalog scope differs from QS per-member scoping and is a product difference, not an equal-prompt microbenchmark.
design.measurementLimits: No timing claim excludes native tool rounds. Startup/cleanup wall time and model task latency are separate. Natural provider caching is observed, not controlled. Model usage is authoritative; CNY is an upper published-rate estimate, not an invoice.
design.cache: record provider cache usage; do not claim a cold cache without provider evidence; distinguish logical tokens, actual cached usage and conservative cost
design.restarts: fresh isolated home per task; continuation/restart uses only that task's home
design.unavailableFeature: record blocked/not-applicable; do not inject new candidate behavior into a baseline
design.heldOut: freeze corpus hash and seed list before running; any tuning invalidates that candidate's held-out claim and requires a new reserved set

acceptance.minimumQuality: all critical checks pass; commercial strict pass rate is not lower than each comparator in this pilot-sized sample
acceptance.qualityStatisticalClaim: one-sided 95% paired non-inferiority bound above -5 percentage points; insufficient power is inconclusive, not passed
acceptance.tokenTarget: at least 15% fewer aggregate tokens per accepted task against EACH comparator, with paired bootstrap 95% interval below 1
acceptance.costTarget: at least 15% lower conservative cost per accepted task including failed attempts against EACH comparator
acceptance.latencyTarget: at least 10% lower median end-to-end latency with no quality loss; show p50/p95 and paired intervals
acceptance.scope: report per Skill/Agent/Team/long-task family; no blanket better/faster/cheaper statement from one favorable subset
acceptance.releaseGate: 144 runs alone may not establish quality non-inferiority; explicitly retain inconclusive outcomes
